performance.verdict: Green score masks zero Google spend and 5 overdue launch milestones.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting — none completed per records.
Meta CPL dropped to ~$74 on 7 leads in 28 days; 3-day signal (Sep 6–8) shows 4 leads at avg ~$52/lead vs 1 lead in prior 3 days — efficiency improving, tiny sample.
Google Ads spend is $0 across all 28 days and all 45 series days — channel never launched, blocking ~$5,000/mo SOW budget allocation.
GBP actions fell to 0 for 8 consecutive days (Sep 1–8) after averaging 3.5/day Aug 12–29; 17 calls in 28 days now fully untracked in recent window.
GHL shows 49 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and 125 contacts — 7 ad leads vs 125 contacts suggests intake pipeline not attributing correctly.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA verification gap alone costs ~$5,000/mo in unspent Google budget.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones due July 31–Aug 1 show no completion event: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting. Google Ads has recorded $0 spend across all 45 tracked days, meaning the ~$5,000/mo Google budget is entirely undeployed. Nacer must confirm status of each milestone and unblock LSA verification as the critical path item. Success check: all five milestones marked complete or escalated with a firm date by 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over next 3 days; 3-day signal at ~$52 CPL on 4 leads — confirm before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3 days (Sep 6–8) produced 4 leads at an estimated average CPL of ~$52, down from ~$74 over the full 28-day window. This is a promising efficiency signal but the sample is too small (7 total leads in 28 days) to act on with a budget increase. Monitor CPL and lead count through Sep 12 before considering a scale move. Success check: if CPL holds at or below $74 on 3+ additional leads by Sep 12, bring a scale proposal to Sohib.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP zero-action streak (8 days) and GHL attribution gap: 125 contacts vs 7 tracked ad leads requires source audit.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for 8 consecutive days through Sep 8 after averaging 3.5 actions/day earlier in August, and 17 GBP calls in the 28-day window are now untracked in the recent period. Separately, GHL holds 125 contacts and 49 opportunities but only 7 leads are attributable to paid ads, suggesting source tagging is broken or intake is logging contacts outside the tracked pipeline. CRM/Ops (Nacer) should audit UTM capture and GHL source fields. Success check: GBP actions resume and at least 50% of GHL contacts carry a confirmed source tag by 2026-09-16.
